# Reusable Quarto story template

Use this as a starting point for an independent scientific story. It is not a rigid page layout and should not become a second curriculum.

~~~yaml
---
title: "Story question?"
subtitle: "One-sentence intellectual promise"
description-meta: "What the reader will understand after this story."
keywords: ["type:deep-dive", "destination:deepen", "topic:story-topic-id", "level:overview", "language:fr", "status:planned"]
lang: fr
toc: true
---
~~~

~~~html
<!--
~~~

*Independent story · about 10 minutes*

## Start with a concrete question

A hook, a puzzle, a counterexample or a surprising observation. State one central question. Do not assume that the reader has opened a canonical lesson or a previous day.

## Build the idea

Explain the mechanism in a few connected steps. Define every symbol before using it. Separate assumptions, mathematical results, empirical observations and hypotheses.

## Work through one example

Use a small numerical or symbolic example that the reader can verify by hand. State what the example demonstrates and what it does not demonstrate.

## Add one visual when it materially helps

Prefer a clear, accessible diagram or plot with a descriptive alternative text and a caption. Do not add a decorative visual merely to satisfy a template.

## Identify a limitation or counterexample

Show where the intuition fails, which assumptions matter, or what the method does not guarantee.

## Challenge the reader

Ask one meaningful question that requires transfer or reasoning, not only recall.

<details>
<summary>Show the solution</summary>

Explain the reasoning, including the assumptions and the common incorrect answer.

</details>

## Optional connection to the canonical curriculum

Link to the relevant lesson as further reading, never as a prerequisite for understanding this story.

### Sources

List primary/authoritative sources and specify which claims they support. Record provenance and licensing for any reused visual.

---

## Author review checklist

- [ ] One central question and one distinct intellectual angle.
- [ ] Understandable without prerequisite days or canonical lessons.
- [ ] Approximately 10 minutes, checked with a reader.
- [ ] One worked example and one meaningful challenge with solution.
- [ ] Mathematical/scientific claims and assumptions checked.
- [ ] Source dossier completed.
- [ ] FR/EN parity across ideas, equations, caveats and examples.
- [ ] Native Quarto rendering inspected on desktop and mobile.
- [ ] Keyboard, contrast, alternative text and link checks passed.
- [ ] No new prerequisite edges or parallel concept registry.
